objective: Select and qualify one historical security-master and delisted-price source before any Architecture v3 model fitting or bulk backfill.

preferred.name: CRSP US Daily Stock Database
preferred.access_condition: Use only if an existing institutional or WRDS entitlement is available.

operational_fallback.name: Massive five-year plan plus independently qualified delisted-security history
components: Massive grouped or flat-file historical bars
Massive ticker events and corporate actions
EODHD delisted-symbol list, historical bars, and symbol-change history as an independent supplement
SEC, FINRA, or Nasdaq corroboration for ambiguous lifecycle events
limitations: The current Massive Basic entitlement is too shallow.
EODHD must be treated as a vendor source until bounded checks pass.

required_checks: Early, middle, and recent pre-consumed-holdout dates are accessible.
Stable identifiers distinguish ticker reuse and case-only symbol collisions.
Alias intervals do not overlap for one normalized symbol unless distinct entities are explicit.
Listing, symbol-change, acquisition, and delisting effective dates reconcile across sources.
Prices are absent before listing and after terminal exit except for explicitly documented when-issued or OTC transitions.
Adjusted and unadjusted bars reconcile to split and dividend events under one documented policy.
Delisting returns or terminal amounts are available, or a prespecified conservative missing-delisting policy can be applied without future information.
No row from the consumed 2026-05-29 through 2026-08-24 holdout is used for source selection.

pass_fail.failure_action: Record the source failure and do not bulk-backfill or fit Architecture v3.
pass_fail.passing_action: Freeze the source contract, hashes, entity schema, adjustment policy, and missing-delisting policy before a resumable bulk reconstruction.

architecture_v3_unblock_condition: A reviewed passing qualification followed by a completed point-in-time bulk reconstruction covering at least 756 trustworthy trading dates.
